tei:div.tei:p: chos rgyal bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so/ /

na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyi ras su ma shor 'bar/ /thugs rje dang ldan rgyun du 'bazis klagazigasablupa yis/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag zhing mchog bod yul gangs chen 'dir/ /de'i sprul pas mi'i 'gro ba spel/ /de rnams mgon du shākya'i rgyal rgyud byon/ de dang de'i rgyu mtshan 'di ltar ro/ /de'ang bod kyi rgyal rgyud nyid kyang*/ rje mang skur rgyal po las rgyud pa sel ma zhugs par 'dod de/ de ni shākya chen po dang shākya li dza byi/ shākya ri 'dagragaklabragablupa rnams las/ ri brag pa ni/ 'phags rgyal gyi yul gnas te/ rgyal po rtsib gyi mu khyud mtha' yas zhes pa la/ bu rgyal po gtum po rab snang de ni/ bcom ldan 'das dang zhag dus mnyam du 'khrungs par byed la/ de'i bu rgyud rgyal po skyabs 'asang klasengablu/ de'i bu bod kyi rjer gyur pa ni/ sngon gyi yig tshang rnams na 'di ltar snang ste/ dang por bod yul 'dir mi med/ mi ma yin du mas gang pa la/ srid pa cha'i sa yang 'dug cing*/ bod khams pa rnams/ dbra/ 'a'abrug kla'abrubluldongs gsum/ rga dang bzhi/ nu 'o was dha gnyis dang drug la bod mi bu ldongs drug zer ba'ang 'dug na'ang*/ thog ma rang ni bod kyi klami'u blurigs bzhi po yin par sems so/ /de rnams bod mi snga shos yin/ khams rigs dbye ba mi'u rigs bzhi bya ba yod pa yin/ ye sang dkar po gnam kyi 'jug thag can dang gcig ye mon nag mo khro chu'i pha wong 'dra ba dang gnyis/ spyang 'ahrig klaphrugabluye shes lha'i sgron ma dang gsum/ mon dzu nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhi'o/ /mi de rnams mang du 'phel nas bod la dbang byas te/ de dus gdong dmar can gyi yul zhes par grags cing*/ ma sang spun dgu rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rgyal phran bcu gnyis/

rgyal phran sil ma bzhi cus rim par dbang byas skad/ mkhan rjes dbang mdzad | de nas smu rje btsan pos bdud po ma bkrang ru bkra srin po yak+ṣa de ba/ klu rgyal gang ba rnams kyi rim par dbang byas so/ /de'i skabs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bkas bskul zhing*/ri bo ta la'i rtse nas byang la zhal 'bazis klagazigasablute/ kha ba can gyi sems can rnams 'dren par dgongs te/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu gzigs pas/ kha ba can 'di ni 'dzam bu gling du/ yul gru chen po lnga'am dgu yod pa'i nang nas/ ngan shos su'ang 'dug cing*/ sangs rgyas kyis zhabs kyi ma bcags/ gsung gi 'od zer gyis ma khyab/ bstan pa'ang med/ gdul byar ma gyur pa mun pa mun nag lta bur 'dug pa la/ stod khams gsum ni gang dang g.ya'i ra ba/ rdzing 'dra ba na/ sha dgo ri dgas kyis dbang byed/ bar khams brag dang spang gi bskor ba/ yur ba 'dra ba na/ spre'u dang brag srin mos dbang byed/ smad khams gsum nags kyi rdzing 'dra ba na/ glang po che dang*/ 'dab chags la sogs pas dbang byed/ mi'i 'gro ba med par 'dul ba'i skabs ma rnyed pa dang*/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams chos kyi snod du ma gyur pa | de rnams 'dul ba la/ thog mar mi rung bsgyur ba'i/ sprul pa btang dgos pa 'dug snyam nas dgongs pa na/ spre'u yi gyad ha lu man+ta zhes pa de 'phags pa'i sku drung na byung ba la/ khyod kyi kha ba can du bsgom nus sam gsungs pas/ nus zer ba la/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom khrims lnga phog mi sdug pa sgom pa'i chos bslab nas btang pas/ spre'u des kha ba can gyi yul gyis dbus/ brag chen gyi rtse la sgom pa'i drung du/ brag srin mo gcig nyin de bzhin byung nas/ mi tshangs par spyod par 'dod pa'i rnams 'gyur sna tshogs dang*/ de'i phyir du srog 'dor ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis tshul ston gyin 'dug nas/

spre'u'i snying rjes ma bzod ste/ 'phags pa'i drung du phyin nas/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ 'phags pa dang sgrol mas gnang ba byin te/ spre'u dang brag srin mos 'dod pa spyad pa las/ zla ba dgu ngo bcu nas pha ma mi 'dra ba spu dang mjug ma med pa gcig skyes pa de ni/ sha dmar po dang*/ khrag draun mo la rab tu dga' ba zhig go /de nags tshogs can du spre'u'i khyur bskyal bas/ spre'u mo dang 'grogs nas lo gcig la de 'dra ba'i phrug gu bzhi rgyar 'phel lo/ /de rnams kyang pha rigs shas che ba ni/ dad pa dang shes rab dang*/ snying rje dang brtson 'grus che ba/ chos dang dge las la mos pa/ blo gros rgya chen po dang ldan pas na/ byang chub sems dpa' blo chen gyi rigs zhes bya'o/ /ma'i rigs shas che ba ni sha khrag la dga' ba/ tshong 'khye klakhebluphogs sems pa/ bdag 'dzin dang chags pa che ba/ skad grags pa/ ngo mi rtag pa/ gzhan gyi skyon 'don pa la dga' ba/ mos gus dang dad pa chung ba/ bya byed mang ba/ mig mi la mi chags pa/ gdong dmar sha zan gyis rigs sha stag byung ngo*/ /rigs rgyud de rnams 'phel ba'i ched du/ 'phags pas 'bras bu sna lnga dang*/ gser la sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs kha ba can gyi phyogs la gtor | byin gyis brlabs/ de la longs spyad pas/ 'aspres sprug klasprel phrug blumir gyur pa de rnams 'bye klajeblumang la song bas/ 'bru la mi 'cham par | tsho bzhir bgos pas/ swe dang smus ldong dang*/ stong dang*/ bzhi la mi'u rus bzhi zer/ la lar dbra 'bru/ 'aspraklasbrablu/ zhang zhung*/ stong sum pa/ ldong mi nyag rnams bgrang pa na/ mi rje lhas mdzad pa ni gong bzhin/ rgya gar du rgyal po skyabs seng gi bu lnga'i bar pa/ mig bya ltar mas nas 'geb pa/ g.yu'i smin ma yod pa/ sor mo dra bas 'brel ba/ dung so 'khor ma yod pa gcig skyes pas rgyal po na re/ ltas ngan du 'dug pas sod gcig gsung pa la/ blon po rnams kyi mtshon gyi bsod ma nus par/

zangs gyi ga'u kha sbyar du bcug gzer gyi bsdams nas/ chu+u bo gang ga la skur ro/ /de grong khyer yangs pa can gyi zhing pa rgan rgon gyi 'asnyed klarnyedablunas/ nags gseb tu gsos pas/ bya dang ri dwags gcan gzan rnams kyi yang zas skom bskyal/ rtse grogs byas/ ljon shing dang me tog kyang de la 'dud par byed do/ /der rgyal bu na re/ nga la 'khor ngan pa 'di lta bu gang yin/ nga'i pha ma su yin zer ba la/ sngar gyi rgyu mtshan bsnyad nas/ khyod phas ltas ngan du byas nas chur bor ba/ nged kyi 'asnyad klarnyedablupa sogs kyi gtam bsnyad pas/ yid skyo nas 'gangs hrag tu klagangs gsebablu bros pas/ lha ri gyang mtho'i mkhar du byung*/ de nas rim gyi 'phyugs nas | kha ba can gyi rgyal khams gyi dbus/ yul yar mo sna bzhi dang*/ lha yar la sham po mthong nas/ der byon/ lha ri gong pho ri rtser phebs/ rmu'i skas la babs te/ rtse thang rgo bzhir byon pas/ ya gam lha sras dang*/ thog lha bon po la sogs shes pa can gyi bu tsha bcu gnyis/ phyugs skyong gin yod pa dang mjal | de rnams kyi khyed su yin byas pas/ btsan po zer/ gang nas 'ong byas pas | mdzub mo gnam la sgreng/ de'i skad ma go yang*/ 'di ni ngo mtshar can gcig 'dug pas/ nges par gnam nas byon pa'i btsan po gcig yin par 'dug 'o cag gis jo bo bya'o zer nas shing gi khri la bzhag gnya' bar khur nas khyim du phyin pas/ ming yang gnya' khri btsan por btags so/ /der phyugs rdzi rnams kyi rje'i bzhugs sa la/ pho brang yum bu bla mkhar brtsigs te/ pho brang snga shos yin/ 'di la rgya gar nas byon pa'i lugs mi 'dra ba 'ga' snang zhing | bon po rnams/ gnam nas rmu thag dang*/ brkyang thag la byon no zer na'ang | gnya' khri btsan por thams cad mthun no/ /baud kyi rgyal po la snga ba de yin te/ 'di ni chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i shes bya rab gsal na | thub pa mya ngan las 'das rting*/

lo stong lhag song pa na byon par bzhed do/ /des sum pa'i bon po a yang rgyal ba btul lo/ /de'i sras 'asmu klamublukhri btsan po/ de nas bu rgyud rim pa bzhin/ ding khri btsan po/ so khri btsan po/ dwa khri btsan po/ 'adhags klagadagasablukhri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po dang bdun la/ gnam gyi khri bdun zer/ de yan chad 'od gsal gyi lha dag yod pas/ sras kyi 'phyibs klachibasablukha thub pa dang*/ yab 'od kyi nam mkha' la byon pas/ lha lus ro med 'ja' ltar yal ces so/ /srib khris sras gri gum btsan po 'khrungs dus/ a phyi 'alhags klagadagasablukyi lha mo dkar mo la/ mtshan ci gsol bris pas/ a 'aci klaphyiblurgas nas/ dbang po mi gsal bar 'bada'aklabarda bludon ma go ba la brten nas/ ming gri gum btsan por btags so/ /de la sras/ sha khri/ bya khri/ nya khri gsum 'khrungs ste/ yab de mu stegs kyi ston pa dig skad pa dang*/ shing sgrod pa dang*/ srog gzan pa bya ba rnams/ mchod gnas su rim par bkur ba'i skyon gyis/ rgyal po'i thugs gdon gyi skyod nas/ rang gi blon po long ngam rta rdzi bya ba la/ khyod kyi nga'i 'thab zla bya dgos zer ba la/ zhu ba phul kyang ma 'alo klanyanablubar/ nyang ro rtsib kyi thal thal tshal du rje 'bangs 'thab pas/ long ngam thabs rten 'brel la mkhas pas/ rgyal po rang gi bod kyi ral gri la snga ba/ dgu zi blang po sna bya ba | de klad la skor bas/ lha'i rmu thag bcad/ lha nyams pas 'bangs kyi bkrongs/ spur de zangs kyi ga'ur bcug nas spyan de'i zam kha nas/ nyang chu 'akya klaskyablumo la 'akyur klaskyurablubatang pas/ rgyang mkhar pa tsha ru dgung zhag bdun dang*/ tshong 'dus mgur mo'i thad du gung zhag bcu gsum chags kyang | 'dzin mkhan med pas kong chu 'aglagaklarlagablu du khyer bas/ klu srin byed mo rje rigs mo'i bran mo/ klu srin bye ma lag rings kyi/ chu la nya bshor du phyin pas/ga 'u 'asnyedaklarnyed blunas/

rje mo la phul bas bang mdzod du sbas so/ /de la stod kyi steng zer ro/ /rgyal bu gsum pos yab mes kyi bang mdzod na/ lha glang ru dkar bya ba'i/ glang 'phur shes gcig yod pa de la bzhon nas kong yul la braus so/ /de rnams kyi ma la long ngam kyi rta rdzi bcol/ lha gcig la chu ma bcol lo/ /ma des rta mtsho ru phyin pas/ gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du/ mi dkar po gcig dang bshos pa rmis/ 'asnyid klaganyidablusad pa dang sngas kha nas g.yag dkar po gcig langs song ngo*/ /zla ba brgyad song ba na | khrag gi gong po lag mgo tsam gcig skyes/ de bor ni ma nus/ gso ba la ni kha mig med/ 'gul gyin 'dug pas 'brong ra gcig gi nang du bcug pas/ rkang rnams kyi ngar ma blo'i drod la btsos pas/ ci zhig tsam na/ bu khye'u gcig byung ba de'i ming*/ 'jang gi bu ru las skyes kyis ngar gsos por btags/ de lo bcu gnyis lon pa dang*/ pha dang pho bo gang na yod 'dri ba la/ sngar gyi rgyu mtshan bshad pas/ spur dang*/ pho bo spun zla 'tshol du phyin/ spur 'asnyedaklarnyed blukyang bslang bas ni mi ster/ rkus pas ni ma thob/ nyos rin ci dgos byas pas/ mi'i bu mo bya lo ma bya mig yod pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa gcig 'dod zer nas/ btsal nas/ dbe'i gang dbar yul gong nas/ pha 'tshar la ra 'than/ ma skyid la ru zhum gyis bu mo dge 'u yu me bya ba/ de 'dra gcig 'dug na nyo bar byas nas/ pha na re gser mo rang tsam gcig 'dod zer/ ma na rai spur de la mtshal gyi thig brgyad cu rgyag chug zer ba/ khas blang bu mo khyer spur blus so/ /kaung yul se mo phug du bang so brtsigs na'ang*/ der ma bzhugs/ bang so rtsig pa'i sngun ma yin no | | de nas gcen sha khṛ kong po dang*/ gcung nya khri dgas po'i rje mdzad nas/ gdan ma drong kong rje dkar po dang*/ nyang btsun rgyal po bya bar grags so/ /da lta'ang de gnyis na rgyal rgyud mang skad do/

/spu bo brag rdog gi rje mdzad pa'i 'bring po/ bya khri gdan drangs nas rgyal sar bcug spu de gung rgyal du mtshan gsol lo/ /spu rgyal bod kyi yul bya ba de nas grags so/ /de nas spu rjai yar lung su gdan drangs pas/ bon po sa ri bu skye rgyal rmang po tshas/ gri btul nas/ lo bcu gsum song ba'i spur zang de kha che nas/ skad nga ra ra zer bas | yul de'i ming ni nga ra thang du btags/ de nas spur de mchong skyes grang mo grangs chu kha'i zoms la sbas pas/ gnam nas gser gyi thi gu gcig byung nas | de la thim pas/ gnam la gser thig tu mtshan gsol/ de nas ru la skyes kyi nyang rong sham po mkhar gyis ri rtse la/ bya rgod kyi gsob du zhugs nas/ lo ngam pho mo dang*/ phrug gu thams cad bsad/ sham pho 'khar gyi rtse phab/ sku mkhar 'phyings nga stag rtse'i rmang rdo byas/ she 'u yug thams cad snang du bcad | der rje pu te gung rgyal 'asnyes klamanyesablunas/ ru la skyes la/ khu khu lha bu smon bzang bya ba'i ming btags/ yab gri gum btsan po'i ring la/ zhang zhung dang*/ gru sha'i bon pos/ bshan gyi dur bon byung ngo*/ /sa zin du bya bar mga' ra spun dgu'i brdung pas/ bod ral dgu zi dang*/ dgu rogs zer ba 'di yang de dus nas dar ba'o/ /sras pu te gung rgyal gyi ring la/ sku mkhar 'a'achi nga kla'aphyings pa blustag rtse brtsigs/ sgrung dang ldeb byung*/ gnam bon bshan po bya ba byung ngo*/ /blon po ru la skyes dang*/ de'i bu lha bu mgo dkar gyi blon po byas pa'i ring la/ 'braung mthun du sdeb/ chu yur bar bcug spangs zhing du rmos/ sol bas rdo gzhus nas/ gser dngul bcos/ rnol rnams ldai/ rnol pa lde/ lde rnol rnams/ lde rnol po/ lde rgyal po/ lde sprin btsan rnams la/ bar gyi sde brgyad ces zer ro/ /lde brgyad bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab/ lde sprin btsan gyi sras/ rgyal po lto re ldong btsan/

thon mi 'bring po rgyal dang*/ smubs smon ngo re/ mdar gyi bu stong mdar chen rnams kyi blon po byas so/ /'di yan gyi rgyal po rnams kyi lha klu'i bu mo dang bshos te/ btsun mo'i gtan dog la ma 'tshal zer nas/ sa la ro ma byung skad do/ /de rting 'bangs dang gnyen sres pa ste/ rgyal po to re long btsan nas/ bu rgyud rim pa bzhin/ rje khri btsan nam | blon po snums gnya' stong re gtsugs lo dang*/ rtabs khri bzung mong kheng gis byas/ rje khri dgra dpung btsan/ blon po mgar khri sgra dzi thun dang*/ mthon ma klu dbang bstad pos byas/ rje khri thog rje thog btsan/ blon mgar btsan gnya' sdom bu dang*/ rlubs skyes thog tse mo btsan gyi byas so/ /de yan mi rje lhas mdzad nas gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar la/ chab srid sgrung dang ldeb/ bon dang gsum gyi bskyangs zer ro/ khri thog rje thog btsan dang*/ ru yong bza' lto rgyal mtsho'i sras/ lha tho tho re snyan btsan ni/ bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po byon nas/ lo dgu brgya drug cu rtsa drug song ba'i me lo yos lo la 'khrungs so/ /de rnams la btsan lnga zer ro/ /rje de'i blon po khri thog rje btsan dang*/ sbrang khri bzung lan pas byas so/ /rgyal po de'i sku ring la rgya gar nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhan po si li byin byon 'a'ang klakyangablu/ bod na yi ge dang lo tsā shes pa gzhan med pas

| rgyal po'i phyag tu mchod pa'i rten la/ rags sku'i rigs lnga cha gcig bzhag nas/ khong rgya nag la byon no/ /der rting rgyal po lo brgyad cu bzhes pa | sa pho spre'u'i lo la/ pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi rtser/ nam mkha' nas zangs kyi ga'u'i nang du/ dpa' skong phyag brgya ba dang*/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ gser gyi mchod rten 'khru gang pa/ tsan dan ma na'i gzungs rnams byon te/ da 'ata'i klanasablugadung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sgra grags so/ /de chos yin par ma go na'ang*/ ngo mtshar can zhig go snyam nas/ pho brang gi rtser bzhugs/ gser skyems dang g.yu sngon sogs kyi mchod pas/ rgyal po dgung lo brgyad cu pa la se'u skyes/ skra dkar rnams nag por gyur/ 'asnyer klaganyerablum med par gzhon sha chags zhing*/ lo brgya dang nyi shu thub/ rten de la 'asnyen klaganyenablupo gsang ba zhes par 'tshan gsol/ nga'i brgyud 'dzin 'di la mchod pa phul la/ gsol ba thob cig 'dod pa'i don rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyal po nyid 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul par grags shing 'di'i ring la/ bod du dam pa'i chos kyi dbu 'asnyeng klabarnyesablupar byed do/ /btsan lnga po'i bang sau thul du btab/ yul gyi ming ni 'phyid lung so ra thang*/ btsan lnga'i chad pa sa phung sbra 'dra yod/ yul med che gru bzhi mi shes skad/ rje de'i sras khri snyan bzung btsan/ blon po sbas snang gzher zla btsan dang*/ mgar khri 'bring gis byas/ khri snyan chad pa don khar mda' ru brtsigs/ de yang yul med sa phung rdal ba 'dra/ de'i sras 'gro snyan de ru | blon po snyag thang pa yang rje dang*/ snubs khri dar res mthong pos byas/ de'i sras stag ri snyan gzigs dang*/ yab sras gnyis la/ bar gyi steng zhes zer | de'i lo rgyus/ 'gro snyen brde ru khab du/ mchims za klu rgyal ngan bu zhes pa'i skyon gyis/

khong rang la klu nad tsi tsi dzā'i la byung nas/ yab yum gnyis blon po snyeg tha pa yang rje dang gsum ka gson dur la bzhugs dgos byung | sras gcig yod pa rmus long du gyur/ ming rmus long skon pa bkra zer/ zhal chems la bsam pa bzang po gser dang 'dra ba ste/ bzang po'i gros ni bdud rtsi yin pas nyon/ /ngan pa rnams ni me dang 'dra bas spongs/ /mi chos rtog pa yin pas rnam rtog skyur/ khyed kyis 'asnyan klaganyanablupo gsang ba mchod | 'a zhi'i sman pa bos la mig phye/ mig ma byung na sum pa'i yul na bon po gcig gis chung ma/ rgyal mo lcam rgya lcam bya ba dang*/ nga nub gcig 'grogs pa la | bu sum 'ari rong klaring poblubya ba yod pa de bos la lcen chol/ rgyal sar chu gsungs so/ /'gro snyen de ru'i bang so zhang 'dar brtsigs/ de nas dmus long kon pa kras/ 'asnyan klaganyanablupo gsang ba rgyas par mchod/ 'a zha'i sman pa bos nas pho brang yum bu'i rtser spyan 'che klaphyeblu'o/ skyid shod stag mo'i ri la | 'asnyan klaganyanablurtsa za ba mthong*/ mtshan yang stag ri snyan gzigs su gsol lo/ /rgyal sar bcug de'i blon po de ni long khrid do rin ri snang btsan dang | sna snang ma snyen/ sbrang khri gsung len rnams kyis byas/ yab sras de gnyis kyi bar du zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhugs/ de skad do/ /snyan gzigs bang so don khar mda' ru brtsigs / gral ni khri snyan go ngos g.yon na yod/ de yang yul med sa phung rdal ba 'dra/ de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ blon po sbas snang bsher dang*/ tshe spongs na ga na gser/ nyang rtso dgu snon ba na sngags gsum rnams kyi byas/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ rgya nag nas rtsis dang*/ sman dpyad byung na'ang cher ma dar/ rgya dang gru gu btul/ nyang sbal gnon gsum mnga' 'og tu bcug sku mkhar khri brtsigs 'bum btugs bya ba/ ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sgrus pa'i 'jin pas brtsigs so/ /rgyal po des smu bde long ba khrid nas brag gsum ding ma/

mtsho'i 'gram nas 'asnyed klarnyedablupa'i rta cang shes la 'phyibaklachibasablu/ sgrangs dga' bo dang*/ smu 'dapun brgyad kladapung rgyang ring blupo bya ba'i gyad mi gnyis kyis khrid nas phung g.yag thal kha ru ring bya ba 'brong na le bong zan bsad nas yong*/ sha bras sga la btags pa sa la lhung pas | lan tsha 'asnyed klarnyedablude/ tsha la drug cu sde byed pa byung*/ de gong bod na lan tsha'i ming med do/ /'di phyin chad pa don kha ru brtsigs/ de nas 'phul skyed brtsigs pa sogs mkhar yod/ gral ni khri snyan bzung btsan g.yon na yod/ /rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan la/ yum tshe spong zer ba yod/za 'bri sa thod dkar gyi sras khri srong btsan ni/ me glang lo la/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gyi gling du/ mes pho tho tho ri snyan btsan nas lo brgya dang dgu bcu go gcig song ba'idus/ sku 'khrungs nas/ lo bcu gsum nas yab 'das/ lo de nyid la rgyal por mnga' gsol | chab srid lo drug bcu re bzhi bzung*/ 'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos kha ba can du byon nas/ gdul bya smin par mdzad pa'i phyir | dam pa'i chos kyi srol bstod pa'i tshul gyis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzung ste/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i mdo dang*/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud las lung bstan pa bzhin yin la/ bod kyi rgyal po lo bcu bzhi pa gcig gis/ rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong gin 'dug ces pa'i snyan grags kyi mdzam bu gling khyab ste/ phyogs bzhi'i rgyal pos nor khyad par can gyi skyes dang yi ge bskur byung dus/ bod kyi rgyal po la skyes lan bskur rgyus nor yod kyang*/ kha 'phrin ma gtogs yi ge med pas/ bod la yi ge ci nas kyang dgos pa 'dugadagongs nas/ thon mo a nu'i bu/ saṃ bho ra mi chung bya ba blo gsal bas gser skur nas rgya gar du yi ge dang chos slob tu btang bas/ mkhas pa li byin na re/ nga'i yi ge bris rigs mi 'dra ba nyi shu shes pas/

rgyal po'i 'gram du rdo ring la yi ge bris yod pa bstan nas/ slob ma khyod gang 'dod zer ba la/ bod kyi yi ge'i lugs 'di bslabs/ /lo tsā yang mkhas par shes/ slob dpon dang paṇ+ḍi ta/ shi la nan ta bya bas/ mdo dkon mchog sprin dang*/ gtog gzungs/ snying rje pad dkar la sogs spyan drangs yongs pas/ rgyal po thugs rab tu dges so//bod kyi lo tsā ba dang*/ yig mkhan la snga ba de yin no/ /rgya gar na yi ge thams cad | dbyangs yig dang gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi la/ mi tshud pa gang yang med na'ang | bod sgra ngan pas de bzhin ma go rgya dkar ba gcig la e ka zer | 'jig rten lo ka chos la dharma/ zhus la gri ta zer la/ smras pa zer dgos pa sogs bod skad du ma khug par/ thon mi thugs mug nas/ gzim khang gi sgo bsdams | chum gzim nas gnyid log sad pa dang*/ gam na rga po gu ba lta bu gcig 'dug rgan po gang nas yong*/ gar 'gro/ ngas sgau bsdoms nas yod pa ji ltar byas nas yong / ci byed byas pas/ chos kyi don la 'gro 'ong med | | yang dag don la ci bya med/ /nam mkha' dag la lam byas pas/ /sgo bya dam pas mi thub pa/ /zer nas/ der the tshom skyes/ yang bskyar nas bris pas | ngas za hor nas yong*/ 'a zhi yul du 'gro zer/ thag ci tsam yod/ ci cha zer | rgyags ji tsam yod/ ja yod zer nas rgan po mi snang bar gyur te/ de ni 'jam dbyangs gyi sprul pa'o/ /de nas bsam pas/ ca cha ja dang gsum/ zha za 'a dang drug byung ba/ de rnams bcug yi ge lnga cu po/ ka smad sum cur bsdus nas | bod kyi sgra skad dang mthun pa'i yi ge 'bru sdeb tu btub pa byung ba dang*/ bod kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ da nga'i yab ma ེ sa kyi gnyan po gsang ba 'di'i nang na | ci 'dug ltos dang zer klog pas/ mdo za ma tog dang*/ pa skongs phyag brgya ba/ tsan ḍa ma ni'i gzungs/ mu tri'i phyag rgya rnams bzhugs 'dug pa la mos nas/ rgyal pos kyang lo bzhir mtshams bcad/

yi ge dang chos bslabs so/ /mdo dkon mchog sprin la sogs pa thon mi'i spyan drangs pa rnams bod du sgyur/ chos sgyur ba'i thog ma yin no/ /chab 'og thams cad la chos dang yi ge rgyas par spel cing*/ bod yig gi thog ma/ rgyal pos jo bo gtso 'khor gsum po'i bstod pa/ 'di brtsams nas lha sa zla ba'i brag la bskos nas phud du phul yod do/ lha skyon gyi ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thugs rje'i 'acanaklaspyan blugyis 'gro la gzigs | | spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje dang ni shes rab gnyis | 'asnyan klamanyam blupar sbyor ba'i thugs mnga' zhing*/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /dpal ldan mnyam sbyor la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'i gtso/ /gsang sngags rgyal po 'asgreng klabagrang blu'aphreng ni | | mu tig ltar dkar g.yas na 'dzin/ /rigs sngags 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo | | 'khor ba'i skyon gyi ma gos pa'i/ /pad+ma shel gyi 'od pas gsal/ /pad+ma dkar po g.yon na 'dzin/ /phyag na pad+mo la phyag 'tshal/ /chos dbyings rnam dag dri ma med/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar rgyas pa'i yum/ /gzugs kyi lha mo yid 'ong ma/ / yi ge drug ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas yon tan gser mdog can/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar/ /sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /nor bu 'dzin pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /de dus rgyal po lo bzhir sgor ma byon pa des/ blon po rnams na re/ rgyal pos ci yang mi shes/ bod bde ba nged rnams kyi byas pa yin zer ba/ rgyal pos gsan nas glen par brtsi na/ bod mi thul dgongs nas rgyal po gcig pu gnas pas kun bde ba yin te/ sngon yang khrims med pas/ shes pa can bcu gnyis mthar 'khyams 'dug /da ngas dge ba bcu la dpe blang ba'i chos khrims bca'o gsungs/ bsad pa la stong gnyis khri gcig stong*/ rkus pa la brgyad cu 'jal/ byi byas pa la yan lag gcod pa/

rdzun byas pas lce 'breg par byas/ yang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims kyi gzhi bzung bar byas te/ dkon mchog la dad pa dang*/ skyo ngal med par sgrubs pa dang don dam par sangs rgyas kyi chos btsal zhing sgrubs pa dang*/ gtsug lag dang chos la blo sbyangs pa dang*/ pha ma la drin lan bsobs pa la slob pa dang*/ yon tan can gyi rigs kyi rgan pa la bkur sti bya ba dang*/ sha nye dang mdza' gshes la gzhung drang por srong zhing*/ khong sems chung zhing dang du slang pa dang*/ ma rtags zhing mi 'dod pa'i las la rtogs 'dod med pa dang*/ yul mi khyim mtshes la 'than klaphanablugadags pa dang*/ gzhi drang por srang zhing khongs sems chung ba dang*/ las dang spyod pa thams cad ya rab kyi rjes su snyegs cing*/ phyi mig ring du lta ba dang*/ zas dang nor la tshod zin pa dang*/ drin chen gyi mi'i lan mi cag bzang lan brlan pa dang*/ bu lon dus la 'jal zhing bre srang la g.yo mi bya ba dang*/ thams cad la snyom par bya shing 'gran sems mi bya ba dang*/ gros kyi nang du bu med kyi kha la mi nyan pa dang*/ rang tshod zin par bya ba dang*/ sems can gang la brdung ba'i sems mi 'chang ba dang*/ byams snying rjes skyong ba dang*/ bcu drug go /bod kyi khrims dang*/ chos rnams sky-id shod sho ma ra na bar gtan la phab pa'o/ /der blon 'bang rnams dga' nas/ rgyal po 'di ni shin tu sgam po gcig 'dug go zer nas/ srong tsan sgam por mtshan gsol lo/ /gzhan yang skye bo tha mal pa rnams/ blo kha chos la drangs zhing dad pa'i phyir/ thog mar sgrung dang*/'a'adebs klaldebabludang*/ bon rnams bstan| rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrung rgyud/ 'a'adebs klaldebablukyi bkod pa ra sa 'phrul snang gis blo 'bur nang na bris nas bkod yod do/ /de dus blon po mang nyang po rje zhang snang la sogs pa mdzangs pa mi drug gis/ tshig drug drug sum cu so drug la sogs pas/ gtan tshigs gtan la phab/

bod ru bzhi stong sder 'byekla'abyedablu/ sku srung phyogs bzhir bskos/ mi la yig tshang skur/ mdo ba'i rta la cho ris bris/ phu chu rdzing du skyil/ gzhung chu yur du drangs/ ri khyim klungs su brtsigs/ thang zhing du slaug zhing lhur bcad/ chu gru btsugs/ bre srang gtan la phab/ mtha'i rgyal phran rnams dang*/ lho mon/ rtsa mi shing mi la sogs pa thams cad mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ chab srid rnams bde zhing skyid par gyur te/ chos lugs la phal cher zhugs so/ /der rgyal po'i dgongs pa la/ nga'i khrims rnams kyang btsan par byung*/ da chos kyi 'dul du btub par 'dug pas chos bya'o/ /chos byed pa la yi dam gyi lha dgos pas/ ci la bya snyam na/ tshes brgyad kyi srod la sprin gseb nas lha'i bu mo na re rgya dkar lho phyogs mthar thug pa rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ bye ma'i gseb/ sing gha'i gling*/ 'a'akhar klakhablus pa ni sku rgyab/ glang po che nyal ba'i 'og gis/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i sdong po'i khog na zhal bcu gcig pa'i sku rang byon gcig yod pa/ spyan drangs na kha ba can du don chen po byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ de la rgyal po thugs rab tu dgyes te/ rang gi smin mtshams nas 'od zer skyes pa'i sna la/ dge slong shrī la a ka ra bya bar sprul nas/ skyod de spyan 'dren pa la gtang ngo*/ /de nas dge slong des rgya mtsho'i 'gram na sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi ring la rtsa ba zug/gser thub kyi ring la lo 'dabs rgyas/ 'od srung kyi dus me tog shar/ shākya thub pa'i dus na 'bras bu smin/ de'i steng la rtsa ba rul nas 'gyel ba bye mas non nas/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i khog nas/ dal po'i mchod cig ces pa'i sgra dang bcas bcu gcig zhal sor bcu gnyis pa/ phyag bcu pa/ ma nu ka'i mdog lta bu/ lta bas chog mi shes pa gcig byon pa de dang*/ tsan dan gyi tshal pa gcig bye ma'i gling nas/

'jag ma'i phon gcig po ta la'i 'dam nas me tog myu gu'i sdong po tshal pa gcig grong khyer ke rus mchod bstan 'khor lo'i nang nas/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ 'od srung/ shākya thub pa rnams kyi/ sku gdung ring bsrel de la bzhugs pas byang chub shing gi mchod sdong gsum/ gnas chen brgyad kyi bye ma/ chu bo na ra dza ra'i 'gram du sangs rgyas kyi lhung bzed nas/ chu bo ba'i shul gyi bye ma/ rin po che sna gnyis rnams dge slong gi bsnams byon te/ mchod rdzas khyad par can bcu po de/ bod kyi rgyal po la phul bas/ thugs rab tu dges shing ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ dge slong de yang rgyal po la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te | de'i smin mtshams su nub po/ /de nas mchod g.yog la mtshan ldan ma bcu drug bskos te/ dus drug tu mchod pa phul cing*/ rgyal po rang lha'i drung nas 'ben gang mi mda' sar bzhugs so/ /de nas yang rgyal po'i thugs la/ de bzhin rten khyed par can de 'dra gdan 'dren rgyu gar yod dgongs nas/ yi dam gyi lha de la gsol ba btab pas/ lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gsum 'phros pa bal yul gyi phar mtha'i lung pa gcig gi tsan dan gyi nags gseb na/ tsan dan ha ri'i sdong po gcig la phog 'dug pa/ yang rgyal pos sprul pa 'askyes klabakyesablunas/ dge slong shi la a ka ra spyan 'dren du btang bas/ nyin mo tsan dan gyi sdong po la/ mtshan mo spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rang byung gsum gong 'og brtsegs mar bzhugs pa| steng ma na re/ nga rgya bal gyi mtshams su zhog gcig

sa de na snga gro re la tshong dpon re sbos 'grib klagrirablu'achi ba yod pa de 'a'aphyadaklachadablu do gsungs jo bo 'ja' ma li'o/ /bar ma na re nga bal yul yam bu ya 'gal du zhog gcig de na mi mang po rims nad kyi 'chi ba yod pa de 'chad do gsungs pa de jo bo u khang ngo*/ /smad ma na re/ nga mang yul skyid grong du zhog gcig zla ba re la grong dpon re 'dze nad kyi 'chi ba yod pa de 'chad do gsungs/ de ni 'phags pa ba ti yin no/ /lha gsum po de ltar bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgyal po la zhus pas/ 'dir ma phebs kyang sems can gyi don chen po byas 'dug gsungs nas/ shin tu dges par gyur to/ /der rgyal po'i thugs la yi dam gyi lha dngos dang mjal phyin/ sems can gyi don la tshegs med/ bod 'bangs kyi 'gro don sa phyogs gang nas 'grub brtag dgongs nas gzigs pas/ mes po tho tho ris byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa des zhabs kyi bcags pa'i 'akyil klaskyidablu smad lha sa 'asmal kladamarablupo 'arigs klarisabluphyogs der/ theg pa chen po'i chos spel du btub par dgongs nas/ mchod gnas rnams shing rta la spyan drangs/ rgyal blon rnams byon/ sbrang stod tshal du bcag mal mdzad/ sang gro btabs sar rgyal po dang blon po tshos chu khar khrus mdzad/ chab gsol dus dbus gyis gye rer yi ge drug ma 'byon par lung bstan no/ /'asmal kladamarablupo ri rtser phebs yab mes kyi bzhugs shul du pho brang btab nas bzhugs/ de nas ngas sems can gyi don byed par dam bcas pa yin pas/ de dag 'dul ba'i thabs gang legs dgongs nas/ lha la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer skar mda' lta bu gnyis/ shar nub du song pas/ rgya nag dang*/ bal yul du thims pas/ khro snyer can dang*/ sgrol ma'i sprul pa spyan drongs zer ba'i sgra byung nas/ sngon la blon po mgar dang*/ thon mi mi chung gnyis gyi 'go byas/

rta pa brgya la gser gyi dong rtse brgya dang*/ gser gyi bang ba bdun/ glang po che gser gyi dra ba lha'i rin po che'i rgyan pa gcig gser phyai bre phyed| yi ge bcu pa'i gser dngul zangs gsum gyi sgrom bu dang bcas pa bskur nas/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad/ skar ma na so'i nyi ma rtse shar la/ bal po'i lha gcig slong ba la brdzangs so/ /der khong rnams kyi/ nub phyogs bal po'i pho brang yam mkhar du slebs/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha dang mjal/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bal bza' khri btsun skal rdzongs bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ yi dam mi bskyod rdo rje/ byam pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan dan sgrol ma'i sku rang byung gcig dang bcas pa gnang ba/ gdan drangs nas pho grangs 'asmalakladamarablupo rir phebs so/ /de nas bal bzas rgyal po thugs mi skyo zhing*/ pha rol gyi dmag gi mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir/ rin po che mang po sbyar/ gnod sbyin pho mo mang po bran du bkol nas/ 'asmalakladamar blupo ri'i khongs su bcug pa'i so phag gi lcags ri/ gyang phor sum cu rtsa gnyis dang mnyam pa/ srin yul lang ka pu grī grong khyer dang 'dra ba/ mkhar dgu brgya dgu cu rtsa dgu'i rtse mo nyag dang stong du tshang ba/ mkhar re re la gdung ba dan dmar po can bzhi re btsugs pa/ phyogs re re na sgo dpe bzhi srung mi yod pa/ rtse mkhar la bya ra ba mi lnga re rgyun du yod pa/ de'i lho ngos lcags ri'i nang na/ pho brang sog po mkhar bya ba dgu thog dang*/ rgyal po'i brtse mkhar mnyam pa/ de gnyis lcags thag gi sbrel nas/ dngul zam la rgyu ba/ mkhar dang lcags ri rnams la mda' yab dang*/ sgo chung dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ pha gu dang*/ kha bad dang*/ rta babs rin po che'i dril bu er kha/ mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed rnams kyi rgyan pa/ pha rol gyi dpung gi mi tshugs pa zha ི ga bzhengs so/ /der rting yang blon po mgar dang*/ thon mi'i 'go byas| rta pa brgya la gser gyi dong brtse brgya/

gser phye bre phyed/ rin po che'i gos gcig rnams bskur nas/ shar rgya nag po'i lha gcig slong ba la brdzangs so/ khong rnams kyi brgya'i bkra shis khrigs sgor slebs/ thang tha'i dzung rgyal po zhus pas/ de'i sras rgya mo kong jo rdzongs ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa| yi dam gyi lha shākya thub pa/ gab rtse drug cu skor/ bzo sna bco brgyad/ sman spyad chen mo/ 'bru sna tshang*/ g.yog pho mo mang po dang bcas pa gnang bod du phebs| lha sa'i mthil bye ma'i gling nags gseb/ chu mig gi 'gram du/ lha'i shing rta byings nas/ gyed lha dga' klu dga'i btegs kyang ma thegs pa/ jo bo de khar bzhugs pa yin/ sa dgra snon pa la dgongs pa'o/ /sku srung la gyad gnyis bzhag gos dar gyi bla yol gyi spyad do/ /der kong jo rgyal po dang mjal| yab yum gsum slob 'bangs dang bcas pa dga' 'a'akhur bcodakla'agu spyod bludo/ /de nas rgyal po'i thugs la/ lha rten gsung rab 'di rnams bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gcig bzhengs dgos dgongs nas | kong jau la rtsis byas pas/ yul de na bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i dge du ma tshang 'dug kyang*/ lar bod yul kha ba can 'di srin mo gan 'gyal klarkyalabludu nyal ba dang 'dra/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrag tu 'dug pa 'di gnon dgos/ de la'ang*/ dang po ru bzhi'i lha khang rtsig dgos zer nas/ dpung mgo g.yas pa la ka tshal/ g.yon pa la 'khrang 'grugaklakhra 'brug blu /brla g.yas pa la tsang 'gram/ g.yon pa la grom pa rgyang brtsigs so/ /yang srin mo'i yan lag bzhi gnon pa'i phyir/ mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi ni/ gru mo g.yas pa la kong po bu chung*/ g.yon pa la lho brag kho mthing*/ dpus mo g.yas pa la ka brag g.yon pa la spra dum rtse brtsigs/ srin mu'i nying lag bzhi gnon pa'i phyir yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi ni/ lag mthil g.yas pa la/ byang 'tshal gyi rlung snon/

g.yon pa la khams sum glong thal sgron me/ rkang 'go g.yas pa la byams sprin/ g.yon pa la mon bum thang skyer chu rnams bzhengs/ der rt-ing ra sa'i rmangs gting yang zhig nas rtsig tu ma btub pa la rgyal pos/ tsan dan gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ sngon la lho phyogs su pho brang brtsig la/ der mchod pa'i bstan ngo mtshar can rnams spyan drongs shig de nas rim gyi 'dod pa 'grub par 'gyur ro zer ba byung nas/ bal bza' la bka' bsgaus nas/ lho phyogs ngos su pho brang rtsigs/ mchod pa'i rten rnams spyan drangs/ rgyal pos yang phebs nas/ sngon la lha khang bzhengs | der rting yi dam gyi lha gcig yang bzhengs par dgongs te/ bal po'i lha bzo ba la bka' 'asnang klaganangablute/ lha'i rgyu khyad par can dang*/ lag cha rnams rgyal po'i spyan sngar bsags/ sang nyin nas lha bzhengs rtsis la | de nub pho brang gi mthong khung na mar/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar shar ste byon/ lha'i rgyu la thims song pas/ rgyal po'i dgongs pa la/ nga'i yi dam 'di la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang byin brlab mnyam pa gcig yong ba 'dug pa shin du legs/ de yang bod kha ba can pa'i lha skal thugs rje chen po rigs lnga cu rtsa gcig gi nang nas/ gang bzhengs na drag dgongs pa la/ sangs nam lang tsa na/ dbu sngas kha na rgyal po rang dang sku bong mnyam pa'i/ bcu gcig zhal gcig rang byon du 'dug pas/ shin du legs na'ang*/ tsan dan gyi sku rang byon 'di dang*/ mchod sdong 'di gsum lha'i khong snying du bzhugs pa gcig byed dgos bsam pa yin te/ gsungs pa dang lha sku rang gi phyag gnyis gyi rang gi sham thabs pus gong du rjes te/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil nas 'od zer 'phros/ tsan dan gyi sku dang mchod sdong gsum po spyan drangs/ thugs khar bzhugs pa'i sku shin du sgram/ a mi dhe ba yang g.yon gyi phyogs su yo/

zhabs sngar shul du byon kyang*/ sham thabs pus gong du lus te/ chags pas rgyal po shin du ngo mtshar cing dgyes par gyur to/ /der rting rgyal pos yi dam la gsol ba btab pas/ zhal dbus ma nas 'od zer byung*/ lho nub zla ba tshal du dug gi sdong po la phogade 'thor bas 'dre srin gyi bdud dpung bshig 'od zer 'phrag pa la phog pas/ 'amakharaklakhablus pa ni dang*/ rta mgṛn/ a mi dhe ba rnams kyi sku dod 'dug pa bzhin 'bur du skos yod cing*/ brag lha chen sdong zhes par grags so/ /'od zer de nub phyogs brag lha klu phug gi ma mo'i nyal sa phrogs | rgyal pos sprul pa skyed nas/ phyag stong spyan stong gi bzo mdzad/ bal po'i lha bzo bas lo gi shwa ri dang*/ mkhar sa pa ni/ dbyangs can ma 'od zer can ma rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rnams bzhengs ste/ gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs so/ /de nas jo mo ru yong za rgyal mo tshun gyi/ ma mo'i nyal sar/ bcom ldan 'das rnam snang kun du 'od kyi zhal brag la 'bur du dod par bzhengs/ pho brang gi lho nub btsan gyi rgyug srang yod sar/ mchod rten ke ru rtsigs/ klu'i pho brang steng gis gser gyi lha shakya mu nes gnan zin/ rgyal pos phyogs bzhi dang*/sa dgra brgyad mnan/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad po gsal bar byas pa ni/ gnam la 'khor lo rtse brgyad sa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi bar na/ han dkar stag mo'i ri la gdugs yod/ rag gis brag la nya yod/ sdong tsan gyi brag la bum pa yod/ grib se sgrom na dung yod/ pugs mi zur na rin po che dpal be'u yod/ shun gyi ri la rgyal mtshan yod/ der ting yon tan thams cad thon pas | ra sa'i lha khang brtsig tu btub par mkhyen nas bod kha ba can du legs so cog 'phel shing*/ nyes so cog sgrib pa'i phyir du/ rgyal pos sprul pa lnga stong bkyes nas lha khang bzhengs/ btsun mo dam pa bal za khri btsun gyis ra sa 'phrul snang*/

rgyal za kong jos ra 'aklargyabluthabs ra mo che/ zhang zhung za li tig sman gyis/ khram bu skog ma/ ru yong za rgyal mo btsun gyis/ brag lha klu phug mon sa khri 'jam gyis/ yer pa'i lha khang rnams bzhengs so/ /ra sa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas lo gsum lon tsa na/ bod 'bangs byin pos nam zla dus bzhi'i/ rtsis ma shes shan ma phye ba la/ rgyal pos dgongs pa la ngas chos 'jig rten gyi khrims 'chos/ bod 'bangs dge la skul thub pa byung na'ang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtaug gi dra ba sel thabs/ rgya dkar nag gi rtsis kyang rgyas par spel nas/ rgyal khams la phan gdags dgos snyam pa 'khrungs te/ bod phrug blo gsal ba/ 'bre gnya' bstan bya ba dang*/ lang mtsho ldong legs/ bya gag stong kun/ mdar mi stag kha dang bzhi po la cha 'askyen klarkyenablumang du bskur nas/ rgya nag la 'artsigs klartsisabluslob tu btang*/ rgya'i rtsis pa khṛr ma ha ya na la sogs la/ lo gcig zla ba bdun gyi bar du gtugs/ gson gshin gyi rtsis phal 'phyeklacheblub shes par byas nas/ yar slebs pas/ rtsis la mkhas pa mi bzhir grags pa byung cing*/ khyad par bya gag stong khun nas/ pha tshe bu rabs su rje'i bla rtsis byas pa'i rigs rgyud ni/ da lta ga rings pa tshang yin par byed do/ /de nas bod rgyal po blon po bcu drug dang bcas nas/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon nas/ rgya'i so kha 'bul ba dang*/ kong jo lan dus kyi khas blang chad btsan par bya ba'i phyir/ lha kha mang po bzhengs/ lo bcu gsum gyi ring la/ rgya bod du lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs tshar ba'i rting ma la/ rab sgang du yong rdzogs lha khang bya ba bzhengs so/ /bka' khol mar chos rgyal 'di'i ring la/ rgya gar nas slob dpon ku ma ra dang*/ bram ze shang ka ra*/ bal po'i slob dpon shi la ma dzu/ rgya nag gi slob dpon ha shang ma ha ya na la sogs pa spyan drangs/ sde snod gsum dang*/ rgyud kyi cha 'alhag klalagablumang rab 'argyur klabasgyurabluzhing*/

rgyal po rang gi zhal nas/ thugs rje chen po'i chos skor ma bu brgya rtsa brgyad gsung | lha sa'i byang chub gling gi rta mgrin zhabs 'og na gter du sbas yod bya ba dang*/ zhang zhung gi yul nas/ bon po'i grub thob zhang zhung lha ldem bya ba bos nas | bod mi a ho rnams bsags/ bya ba bon slob tu bcug nas/ nad pa'i rims 'gro sogs la bon yang dar bar mdzad do/ /zer ba 'dug mdor na bod 'bang rnams lung gi chos la yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ khro bo dkyil du nad pa dang*/ sman pa dang*/ mo ma rnams dang*/ bon bos shwā ba nam mkha' la 'gro sha ེ sa pa sprul nas/ nad brtag pa dang*/ de la khrom rnams ngo mtshar skyes pas | da ltar gyi nad pa 'di 'dra rnams las/ ches na ba'i ngan song gsum dang | 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal brjod pas yid ma ches/ spre'u'i gyad ha lu ma ñdzu'i sgrung 'astang klabashadablunas bod kyi rigs rgyud dang*/ las kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gsung pa mdo sde dang sbyar bas yid ches/ bslab pa gsum la 'god pa'i phyir/ bon byas nad pa gso las phan che ba'i bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan sangs rgyas kyi rgya gar du mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i dod por/ rgyal pos ra sa'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa'i lo rgyus yod cing*/ khro bo sme brtsegs kyi rgyab na mchod rten rgyas po bya ba yod do/ /de lta bu'i chos rgyal chen po 'di ni/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos yin par grags zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol legs po bstod nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa sa pho khyi lo shar ba'i stod la/ spyi dgos su zhal gdam mang du gsungs zhing*/ der rting rgyal po dang*/ bal bza' khri btsun/ rgya bza' kong jo yab yum gsum kar 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang byang mar/ rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs khar thims so/ rgyas par bka' chems bka' khol mar lta bar bya'o/

/'ga' re rgyal po 'phan yul zal mo sgang du grongs zer ba 'dug ste/ blon po sna chen po dang se ru gung ston la sogs/ gros la dbang ba rnams kyi bod 'bangs byin po spro ba 'phrid pa'i phyir du re zhig zal mo sgang du snyung ba skad dang*/ sku bshegs pa'i tshul byas par byed do/ /rgya bza' kong jo lcags mo glang lo la rgya nag nas byon/ bod yul du lo lnga cu rtsa brgyad bzhugs par byed do/ /srong btsan bang sau 'a'achong skyes kla'aphyongs rgyasablumada' ru btab/ /che chung tshad ni dpag chen mda' rgyang gang*/ /nang na lha khang lnga yang byas so skad/ /bang so nang rgyan can du grags pa yin/ /bang sau gru bzhir rtsig pa de nas byung*/ /ming la rmu ri rmug po legs so skad/ /rje de dang lon bza' khri lcam gyi sras/ gung srong gung btsan/ blon po ni mang po rje zhang snang dang*/ snubs tsan do res byas/ chab srid lo lnga bzung*/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la 'das nas/ slar yang yab kyi rgyal srid bzung ba phyed mar bgrang skad | gung srong bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /gral ni rnam ri srong btsan g.yon na yod/ /ming ni gung sri gung chen legs so skad/ /rje de dang sha bza' kong jo mo rje'i sras/ mang srong mang btsan lo bcu gsum nas/ mes po 'das/ lo bco lnga'i bar la srid bzung*/ blon po mgar 'gadongaklastongablubatsan yul zung dang*/ mchims 'das snyer gyi byas/ lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la gtsang gi bang snang du 'das so/ /mang srong bang so srong btsan g.yon na yod/ ming sdong shar sral po bya ba lags/ rje de dang 'gros khri se khri ma lod kyi sras

| 'dus srong mang po rje klu nam 'khrul gyi rgyal po ni/ chu mo bya lo ba ste/ ma 'khrungs gong tsam du yab 'das/ 'khrungs 'phral nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar la srid bzung*/ 'di'i ring la bod du rol mo'i rnam grangs mang po 'byung ba'i snga ltas la/ rtsal po che mi bdun byung ba ni/ ar po gdong can gyis seng ge dkar mo'i gnya' ba nas bzung byung skad/ mon khri bzang gi stag dar ma gnyis lcags thag gi sgrel nas ngar sgras lung pa skang ste khṛd byung skad | lho don dam yang dag 'phags kyis/ seng ldeng gi gdung chen po bcu gsum gyi steng du/ gong dza la lcags dos gcig rgyab nas khur byung skad/ lcog ro zang dkar gyis/ lha sa'i rdo ring sked la btsugs nas yo ga yo gi khur byung skad | rngog rings nag pos bal yul nas glang po che'i phrug gu gcig gson por khur byung skad/ mgos shag byung gi sha ba yu mo'i rlud bu tshas rgyangs nas klad la dbyug gin byung skad/ rmon rgyal mtshan rnam grangs kyis/ mig mthong gsum de mda' rgyang gang res sleb cing*/ gtsang po la phar mchongs tshur mchongs byed kyin sleb byung skad do// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/bod kyi rgyal rabs kyi skor/ -PAGE 108--PAGE 107-
